title: equisetum limosum f. polystachium
intro: Equisetum limosum f. polystachium, commonly known as marsh horsetail, is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the Equisetaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, improve kidney function, and reduce inflammation. The plant is also known for its therapeutic actions, such as diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of urinary tract infections and improve overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Equisetum limosum f. polystachium include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
